name: Nub — Fast TypeScript/Node Toolchain
description: Installs nub (nubjs.com): a Rust binary that runs TypeScript/JavaScript files, package.json scripts, and local CLIs directly on the Node.js and package manager already in the container — no new runtime, no lock-in. Does not manage Node versions itself (dependsOn the official node feature), so it never competes with this container's own version-selection mechanism.

version.description: Version of nub to install (latest, or a specific release like 1.2.3).

installGlobally.description: Symlink nub and nubx into /usr/local/bin so they're available system-wide (all users, root, sudo) without relying on the user's PATH.
